description: This Kotlin source file defines a singleton object 'CategoryManageDialog' which provides UI functionalities for managing categories within an Android application. It includes methods to display a dialog for adding, renaming, and deleting categories, along with internal helper methods for prompting user input.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a dialog allowing management (add, rename, delete) of categories, with customizable callbacks for each action.

methods.name: promptForName
methods.description: Prompts the user to input a category name with a dialog, then invokes a callback upon confirmation.
